requirements.title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
requirements.description: A website designed to help users solve ACM-style competitive programming problems.

features.name: Problem Library
features.description: A comprehensive library of ACM-style problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Submission and Evaluation
features.description: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive automated feedback on correctness and performance.

features.name: User Profiles and Progress Tracking
features.description: Enables users to create profiles, track their progress, and view their problem-solving history.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance.

features.name: Hints and Tutorials
features.description: Provides hints and tutorials for solving problems to help users improve their skills.

constraints: The platform must support automated code evaluation.
The system should handle multiple programming languages.
requirements.target_users: Competitive programming enthusiasts, students, and professionals preparing for ACM contests.
requirements.data_requirements: The platform must store user profiles, problem data, submission history, and leaderboard information.

tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing code submissions and results.

tasks.description: Develop the frontend interface for user profiles and progress tracking.

tasks.description: Develop the backend logic for managing user profiles and tracking progress.

tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing user profile data.

tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying the leaderboard.

tasks.description: Develop the backend logic for calculating and displaying leaderboard rankings.

tasks.name: Set Up Leaderboard Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing leaderboard data.

tasks.description: Develop the frontend interface for displaying hints and tutorials for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Hints and Tutorials Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic for managing hints and tutorials.

tasks.name: Set Up Hints and Tutorials Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing hints and tutorials.

tasks.name: Test Problem Library Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the problem library works as expected.

tasks.name: Test Code Submission and Evaluation
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure code submission and evaluation work correctly.

tasks.name: Test User Profiles and Progress Tracking
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure user profiles and progress tracking work as expected.

tasks.name: Test Leaderboard Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the leaderboard works as expected.

tasks.name: Test Hints and Tutorials
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure hints and tutorials are displayed correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy ACM Problem-Solving Platform
tasks.description: Deploy the platform to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Use a component-based UI framework to design an intuitive interface for browsing, searching, and filtering problems.
T1.notes: Focus on user experience and responsive design.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle CRUD operations for problems, including search and filter functionalities.

T3.implementation_approach: Design a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and difficulty levels.
T3.notes: Optimize schema for search and filtering.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a form-based interface for users to submit code, with syntax highlighting and file upload support.
T4.notes: Include real-time validation and error handling.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement a sandboxed environment to execute and evaluate user-submitted code against test cases.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a database schema to store code submissions, results, and execution logs.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface to display user profiles, achievements, and progress.
T7.notes: Focus on personalization and visual appeal.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage user profiles, including CRUD operations and progress tracking.
T8.notes: Ensure secure handling of user data.

T9.implementation_approach: Design a schema to store user information, achievements, and progress data.

T10.implementation_approach: Create a leaderboard interface to display top users based on various metrics.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to fetch and update leaderboard data based on user performance.

T12.implementation_approach: Design a schema to store leaderboard data, including user scores and rankings.

T13.implementation_approach: Design an interface to display hints and tutorials for problems.
T13.notes: Ensure content is easily accessible and well-organized.

T14.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage hints and tutorials, including CRUD operations.

T15.implementation_approach: Design a schema to store hints and tutorials, including text, images, and videos.

T16.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests to verify problem library functionality.
T16.notes: Focus on edge cases and performance.

T17.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system using various programming languages and edge cases.

T18.implementation_approach: Test user profile features, including progress tracking and achievements.

T19.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard functionality, including sorting and real-time updates.

T20.implementation_approach: Test hints and tutorials for accessibility and correctness.

T21.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform using a cloud provider with CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment.

from app.controllers.problem_controller import problem_bp
from app.controllers.user_controller import user_bp
from app.controllers.solution_controller import solution_bp

def register_blueprints(app):
    app.register_blueprint(problem_bp)
    app.register_blueprint(user_bp)
    app.register_blueprint(solution_bp)

from flask import Flask, render_template
from app.database import db
from app.routes import register_blueprints

def create_app():
    """
    Factory function to create a Flask application instance.

    Returns:
        Flask: The Flask application instance.
    """
    app = Flask(__name__)

    # Configure the app (add configurations here if needed)
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///app.db'
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False

    # Initialize database
    db.init_app(app)

    # Register blueprints
    register_blueprints(app)

    # Define a default route
    @app.route('/')
    def index():
        return render_template('index.html')

    return app

from app import create_app

# Create the Flask application
app = create_app()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Run the Flask application
    app.run()

code_repository.readme_content:
# ACM Problem-Solving Platform

A website designed to help users solve ACM-style competitive programming problems.

## Features

- Problem Library: A comprehensive library of ACM-style problems categorized by difficulty and topic.
- Code Submission and Evaluation: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive automated feedback on correctness and performance.
- User Profiles and Progress Tracking: Enables users to create profiles, track their progress, and view their problem-solving history.
- Leaderboard: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance.
- Hints and Tutorials: Provides hints and tutorials for solving problems to help users improve their skills.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
